sloka: स तम् उन्मादयामास मृगरूपो निशाचर ।मृगैः परिवृतो अथ वन्यैः अदूरात् प्रत्यदृश्यत ॥३-४४-१०॥
transliteration: sa tam unmādayāmāsa mṛgarūpo niśācara ।mṛgaiḥ parivṛto atha vanyaiḥ adūrāt pratyadṛśyata ॥3-44-10॥

translations.english: That demon transformed himself into a deer and, surrounded by the animals of the forest at close range, attracted his attention.
